_comment: Step 5b: the combat-time reflection target is SEARCHED. A settled Boros Reckoner carrying Guilty
Conscience attacks for 3 (20 -> 17); GC deals 3 back, the Reckoner dies and its last-known reflection
of 3 is a CHOICE made inside combat. Aimed at the face it leaves the opponent at 14 (the old unpinned
default). Aimed at the summoning-sick Stuffy Doll (chosen: the opponent), which carries its own GC, it
starts the Doll+GC loop and kills this turn. The sick Doll cannot ping, so only the combat choice wins
turn 4; without the combat fan the first win is turn 5 (the Doll's ping).
